Competitors are retro-audio:music (a short looping chiptune score rendered from MML), pixel-art:vfx (visual effect sprite sheets such as explosions and hit sparks, a picture rather than a sound), pixel-art:scene (a self-contained HTML pixel-art scene that can play a WAV it is given), speech:narrate (text-to-speech narration with word timings), playwright:demo-video (a produced demo video of a web UI change for a pull request) and user-interface:write-animation (one interface animation in an app's own stack). sfx owns rendering one retro sound effect to a WAV from a preset (coin, jump, laser, explosion) or an sfxr-style parameter set.
